data_output.description: Unchanged current encode(splits) contract: it returns encoded and total dimension. encoded["train"] and encoded["valid"] are (features, labels, users); encoded["test"] is (features, users). features is int32 shape (rows, 5), with columns in exact order user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday. All vocabularies are fitted on train only; unseen values use each field's train-fitted unknown index. hour is derived as floor(numeric hourmin / 100) constrained to 0..23, and weekday is calendar weekday from YYYYMMDD date with Monday=0 through Sunday=6.

model_input.description: Model receives the unchanged int32 features matrix and total encoded dimension. It uses features[:,0] for user embedding lookup, features[:,1] for video embedding lookup, and features[:,2:5] exclusively for tab/hour/weekday residual-weight lookup. Labels are supplied only to step(features, labels). logits(features) and predict(features) return one score per input row in input order.
